info.name: Get the ephemeris search request details

items.docs: This endpoint is anonymous. The request ID can be shared with anyone.
Attempts to cancel the search request. The system will log an error against the request noting the cancellation.

info.name: Get the ephemeris search result data

params.name: data_source_record_format
params.description: Control which epehermis source data is returned. Default is basic.

items.docs: Get the data returned by the given search request. If the data has expired, then 404 will be returned.

info.name: Get the ephemeris search result data

items.docs: Get the data returned by the given search request. If the data has expired, then 404 will be returned.

info.name: Delete a search result data file.

items.docs: Deletes the data file containing the search results. If this search is run in the future, the query will re-create the data file.

Anonymous unless logged in. Just like a conjunction search, but contains one side of the query. Used to search  for particular ephemeris data of one or more Data Sources. Maximum time span returned is 1 month. Must provide at least one filter parameter. 
 ** If you are logged in, your search will be private to only you, otherwise it is public **

params.name: data_source_record_format
params.description: Control how the epehermis data source is returned. Default is basic. This option will be used if the advanced format is not present in the request body.

items.docs: Anonymous unless logged in. The same search functionality as asynchronous search, except it is synchronous. Because of the synchronous nature, the maximum time frame is significantly reduced to a maximum of two days. These requests are not saved, even if you are logged in.
